name: Daisuke Jigen
source: Lupin's reliable companion. A gun expert with a rapid fire rate of 0.3 seconds. He loves combat magnums and has top-notch knowledge of firearms. He is a cool guy who wears his trademark hat over his eyes and rarely changes his expression. He is always being swayed by Lupin and Fujiko, but this time...?
